name: EPIC 212566229

text.card: A red giant 4,003 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.80 solar masses and 10.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,990 K at its surface.
